# AnandTech Forums

> > Community forums for technology enthusiasts covering hardware reviews, troubleshooting, PC building, and deal sharing

AnandTech Forums is a long-running technology community where enthusiasts discuss PC hardware (CPUs, GPUs, motherboards), software, peripherals, and share deals. The forums feature dedicated sections for hardware troubleshooting, product discussions (ASUS, nForce2, Athlon, GeForce), and an active Hot Deals community tracking pricing on components and tech products.

## Key Topics

- Hardware troubleshooting and compatibility
- Hot Deals and pricing discussions
- ASUS motherboards (A7N8X, nForce2)
- AMD Athlon processors
- NVIDIA graphics cards (TNT2 Ultra, GeForce3)
- Windows operating system support
- RAM and memory deals
- PC cases and cooling solutions
- BIOS updates and firmware
- Computer mice and peripherals
- Gaming hardware discussions
- CPU coolers (Thermalright)
- Network interface cards (NICs)
- Forum moderation and structure

## Hardware Discussion & Support

- [Windows](https://forums.anandtech.com/forums/windows.10): Windows software forum section for desktop OS discussion and support
- [Mice](https://forums.anandtech.com/forums/mice.83): Computer mice and input devices forum section for hardware discussion
- [Official ASUS A7N8X/Deluxe (nForce2) Thread](https://forums.anandtech.com/threads/official-asus-a7n8x-deluxe-nforce2-thread.324): Official discussion thread for ASUS A7N8X nForce2 motherboard support
- [Athlon+TNT2 Ultra=D3D Problems](https://forums.anandtech.com/threads/poll-athlon-tnt2-ultra-d3d-problems.149): Forum thread discussing D3D compatibility issues with Athlon CPU and TNT2 Ultra GPU
- [GeForce3 & 2D](https://forums.anandtech.com/threads/poll-geforce3-2d.274): Poll discussing GeForce3 graphics card 2D display quality concerns
- [Thermalright Ultra-120](https://forums.anandtech.com/threads/thermalright-ultra-120.3359): Discussion about Thermalright Ultra-120 CPU cooler installation on ASUS mobo
